Mod.Name: Extra Customer
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Call the customers you want. Press F8 while the shop is open to pick any of the game's ~150 regular buyers, sellers, barterers and service customers, grouped by what they trade (food, water, medical, materials, household, substances, cigarettes/stamps/injectors, weapons, firearms, contraband, specialists...); one click puts them at the end of today's queue. Shift+F8 adds a random customer. Rebind under Options > Keybinds. Every morning it also adds extra random customers (1 by default; 0 to 10 in this mod's settings).
